verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-protection SaaS platform that could plausibly offer scheduled reports or recurring workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only event-driven API calls (Checkout, Sale, Chargeback) and decision webhooks, with no documented scheduling or recurring-job capability. Polling the Get Decision API would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
